version: v1.5.1 — FPS Boost + Turbo F2/F10 + Fast World Gen
name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get smooth 60 FPS and make Speed 3 actually fast, but works great on all PCs!

WHAT IT DOES:
- Massive FPS Boost (removes 8K textures, 3D clouds/atmosphere, and UI blurs)
- Turbo Speed 3 (>>> runs at ~16 days/sec with smooth daily date counter)
- Fast World Gen (~80s faster New Game load, skips redundant route prewarm)
- Month-End UI Browsing (browse budget/trade/stats during ticks without freezing)
- Hotkeys: F10 toggles Fire Graphics, F2 toggles Turbo Speed 3 (F11 fullscreen untouched)

EASY 1-CLICK INSTALL:
Run the installer once (Steam Workshop only loads textures by default):
1. In Geoplanetical main menu, click "Mods".
2. Click "Mod studio" on this mod, then click "Open folder".
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait until it says Done.
4. Launch the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10] · TURBO [F2]' and FPS in top-right corner.

HOW TO TOGGLE OR UNINSTALL:
- Press F10 to toggle Fire Graphics ON/OFF with on-screen toast.
- Press F2 to toggle Turbo Speed 3 ON/OFF.
- Or turn off in Mods menu, or run Uninstall-Mod.bat to restore original files.

OUR JOURNEY & CHANGELOG:
